supplementaryChatEvaluation.finalConclusion: qwen3.8-flash remains the winner across all 21 evaluated models: all four gates pass with the best latency profile (t1 1.2s / t2 5.9s / t3 1.4s). Qwen3.8-Max is the same-family quality fallback (all gates pass, t1 1.4s, generation 2x slower); kimi-k2.6, qwen3.7-plus and GLM-5.2 are close alternates. NOTE: this harness measures routing behavior and format compliance, not deep reasoning quality - a Max-tier model may still review contracts better even though it is slower.
supplementaryChatEvaluation.harnessBias: models calling only the skill pseudo-tool first (strict skill-first) were initially marked tool=WRONG; that is correct production behavior, corrected in the supplementary runs (SKILLONLY).
